notes.title: Overhaul Update
notes.content:
[p]The [b]Overhaul Update[/b] is now officially live on the [b]default branch[/b] of Crunch Element! After nearly a year of rebuilding and redesigning core systems from the ground up, this update marks the beginning of a new chapter for the game.[/p][quote][p][b]The old version of the game has been moved to the “legacy” branch.[/b]
To access it:
[b]Steam Library → Right-click Crunch Element → Properties → Betas → Select legacy from the dropdown.[/b][/p][/quote][p][/p][h2]What’s New[/h2][p]This update is a [b]new foundation [/b]for Crunch Element. The mission structure, objectives, progression systems, networking, and enemy AI were rebuilt based on player feedback, and support a scalable framework to build on moving forward.[/p][p]While new modes and content are coming soon, this update introduces the systems that will drive them. Here’s what’s live:[/p][h3][/h3][h2]New & Improved Gameplay Features[/h2][p]✅ [b]New Contract System[/b] – Missions are now structured as [b]multi-stage contracts[/b] with modular objectives, story integration, and reward progression.
✅ [b]Player Progression System[/b] – Earn XP, level up, and unlock gear to shape your loadout and playstyle.
✅ [b]Smarter Enemy AI[/b] – Enemies now [b]coordinate, investigate, call out threats, flank[/b], and take cover. Behaviors are more dynamic and lifelike than ever.
✅ [b]New Enemy Types[/b] – Face off against a variety of Cultist units: [b]bomber enemies, turrets, and riflemen[/b]. Enemies can now [b]drop from the skies or emerge from tunnels[/b].
✅ [b]Compound Alert System[/b] – Compounds now shift between stealth and high-alert states with [b]dynamic music, security levels, and enemy responses[/b].
✅ [b]Massive Performance Gains[/b] – Hitboxes, physics, destruction systems, and lighting have all been [b]rewritten for higher frame rates and VR responsiveness[/b].
✅ [b]Hideout Rework [/b]- The hideout is now more expansive with a ship hangar, contract terminal, and a cantina to relax with friends!
[/p][h2]New Player Tools & Gear[/h2][p]🔑 [b]Keycard System[/b] – Unlock secured areas, crates, and even turrets.
🛠️ [b]New Hacking Stations[/b] – Interact with enemy tech to disable defenses, open doors, and progress objectives.
🎯 [b]New Ammo Types[/b] – Equip [b]tracer rounds[/b], [b]slugs[/b], and [b]special projectiles[/b] to suit your tactics.
🔍 [b]Scanner Attachment[/b] – Spot enemies and hidden points of interest.
🧠 [b]FPV Missile Headset[/b] [b]& Airstrike Grenades [/b]– Take over a missile and guide it in first-person for precision strikes, or throw an airstrike grenade to trigger a bombing run. These are hidden in certain stages, but may be built on in the future.
📡 [b]Tablet-Controlled Grenade Turrets[/b] – Drop automated turrets and rain fire from afar.
🛡️ [b]New Armor System[/b] – Armor choices now directly impact survivability and movement.
🧰 [b]Item Mod System[/b] – Enhance your weapons and gear with passive modifiers like [b]faster reload, stealth bonuses, or explosive power[/b].
🎭 [b]Hat System[/b] – Unlock cosmetics to express your style while blowing holes in cultist fortresses.
🎒 [b]Pouch-Based Ammo System[/b] – Overhauled inventory for smoother, more intuitive VR ammo management.
💣 [b]Timer-Activated C4 Charges[/b] – Time your explosives with precision.
🔨 [b]New Breaching Hammer Charge[/b] – Hold to build power and [b]shatter entire walls[/b] with force.[/p][p][/p][h2]World & Immersion Upgrades[/h2][p]🎨 [b]All-New Art Style[/b] – Environments, enemies, weapons, and effects [b]completely reimagined[/b] for a gritty tactical sci-fi VR feel.
🧱 [b]Custom Shaders[/b] – Real-time gameplay feedback through [b]stylized hits, impacts, and effects[/b]—from bullet pings to wall fractures.
🌟 [b]Fully Precomputed Lighting[/b] – 100% baked GI and directional lighting for massive performance boosts across systems with improved visuals.
🚀 [b]Player Ship Replaces Truck[/b] – Start every mission aboard a [b]dropship[/b] that handles arrival and extraction.
🎧 [b]New Sound Design[/b] – Hear the difference with [b]enhanced impact sounds, voice lines, alerts, and graze zones[/b] as bullets fly by.
🎮 [b]Overhauled UI & HUD[/b] – New hand menus, objective tracking, mission selection interfaces, and feedback systems. If you prefer a more hardcore experience, you can disable the HUDs in the settings.
📡 [b]Real-Time Transmissions[/b] – Missions now feature in-world NPC transmissions for [b]briefings, updates, and story progression[/b].
🖥️ [b]Security Cameras[/b] – Watch your six. Cultists now monitor their compounds with cameras that report intrusions.
🎢 [b]Ziplines & Elevators[/b] – Navigate vertically and escape quickly with new traversal tools.
💥 [b]Massively Improved Destruction[/b] – Every explosion, wall breach, and shattering event is smoother, more immersive, and more satisfying.[/p][p][/p][h2]📣 Join the Mission[/h2][p]Found a bug? Have a suggestion?
Submit it here: [/p][p][url="https://crunchelement.featurebase.app"]https://crunchelement.featurebase.app[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Follow on Twitter/X for real-time updates: [url="https://twitter.com/CrunchElementVR"]@CrunchElementVR[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for patches and announcements about the future roadmap. [b]The Cultists are mobilizing. New missions are on the horizon. And your loadout is ready.[/b][/p][p]See you in the hideout,
— Blake[/p]

notes.title: Crunch Element - Progress Recap
notes.content:
It’s time for an update! Over the past several months, we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, completely overhauling Crunch Element with new features, gameplay improvements, a sprinkle of lore, and a fresh coat of explosive chaos.

We’re not just talking about tweaks and polish—this is a huge transformation, bringing new mechanics, visuals, enemies, tools, and an improved experience to every mission. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s been added:

[h3]New & Improved Gameplay Features[/h3]
✅ New contract system – Stages, objectives, and contract progression have been reworked for a more structured and immersive experience.
✅ Progression system - earn XP after every stage and level up to unlock new gear to create your perfect loadout.
✅ New enemy AI – Smarter, deadlier foes with improved behaviors, better animations, and dynamic responses. Enemies now call out threats, take cover, investigate suspicious activity, and give you a fight like never before.
✅ New enemy types – The cultists are your opposition and they are fearless. Face off against bomber enemies, riflemen, and even enemy turrets guarding their compounds. Be aware of the compounds they lurk in or the skies they drop down from...
✅ Enemy alert system – Compounds now shift between stealth and high-alert states, affecting enemy responses, security measures, and even dynamic music changes.
✅ Huge performance improvements – Everything from hitboxes, physics, destruction, and lighting has be optimized for performance.

[h3]New Player Tools & Gear[/h3]
🛠️ New hacking stations – Take control of key systems inside enemy compounds.
🔑 Keycard system – Unlock doors, crates, and turrets with security access.
🎯 New ammo types – Tracer rounds, slugs, and projectiles for enhanced combat tactics.
🔍 Scanner attachment – Get better visibility on enemy positions and points of interest.
🛠️ Item Mod System – Customize and upgrade your gear with powerful modifications.
🔍 FPV Missile Headset – Take control of guided missiles for precise strikes.
📡 Tablet-Controlled Grenade Turrets – Set up automated defenses and rain fire on enemy positions.
🛡️ Armor system – Players now have armor that affects survivability, adding more depth to combat encounters.
🎭 Hat System – Because even tactical operatives need some drip.
🎒 Pouch-based ammo system – A more intuitive and streamlined inventory system, making ammo management smoother and more natural.

[h3]New World & Immersion Features[/h3]
📡 Real-time transmissions – Key moments now trigger NPC dialogue, status updates, and mission briefings, keeping you engaged and informed.
🌌 New art style and models – Environments, enemies, and effects have been greatly improved visually.
🚀 Player ship replaces truck – Your spawn point is now a fully functional dropship.
🛠️ New mission objectives – Entry-based objectives, wave defense, and elimination missions add new layers of strategy.
🎧 Graze zone system – Experience realistic whizzing sounds as bullets fly past.
🎮 New UI elements and sound design – A completely refreshed interface and audio mix for better immersion.
💥 Greatly improved destruction – Smoother destruction physics and stylized visuals.
🖥️ Security cameras – The cultists have some extra eyes to watch out for...
⚡ Ziplines & elevators for fast traversal – Because sometimes, you just need a quick escape.

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
While the update isn’t out just yet, we’ll be dropping teasers, gameplay clips, and deep dives into the new systems over the next week and beyond. Make sure to follow our X (Twitter) [url=https://x.com/CrunchElementVR]@CrunchElementVR[/url] for exclusive first looks and casual clips as we continue development.

Stay sharp, the next phase of Crunch Element is almost here.

notes.title: The New Rogue Mode Update is Finally Here!
notes.content:
[h1]Rogue Mode[/h1]
[h3]Summary[/h3]
Start with a minimal kit, acquire weapons and attachments along the way, and survive as many rounds as possible with ever increasing difficulty!

[h3]Mystery Boxes[/h3]
Spend credits at the Mystery Boxes located in every level to acquire new weapons during a run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/fccb4839dfc7c5bc08798c17ffc52e3d5a8112d8.gif[/img]


[h3]Upgrader[/h3]
Drop your weapon in the upgrader located in the truck and level up your loadout during a run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/6f33ac589fbdfea8a2eae5eb95522ae74731a61c.gif[/img]


[h1]Enemy AI Rework[/h1]
A complete overhaul to the enemy AI system has finally been done. This fixes many bugs with the old system, introduces more engaging gameplay, and improved performance to support more enemies per map!

[b]Wandering[/b] - Enemies now wander around the map.

[b]Difficulty[/b] - A Difficulty setting has been added for freeplay stages and enemies become progressively more difficult in rogue mode.

[b]Investigation[/b] - Enemies now investigate suspicious activity and combat areas.

[b]Performance[/b] - Performance of the AI has been improved which allows more enemies per map.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
- Added new rogue mode
- Added mystery weapon boxes to all levels for rogue mode and operations
- Added new weapon upgrader in the truck for rogue mode and operations
- Added more starting magazines to the S12
- Added credit reward for completion of objectives
- Added credit display to the wrist watch
- Added new tactical gloves for the player hands
- Complete enemy AI rework
- Added difficulty adjustment to enemies that can be selected on stages
- Update credit tracking to be individual instead of shared across all players
- Fixed issue with new players joining a session not spawning with full health
- Added lifetime stat screen in the hideout
- Fixed issues with hitbox accuracy on map obstacles
- Fixed issues with espionage objective occasionally not spawning
- Fixed issue with building modules not spawning on certain game resets
- Fixed issue with movement speed being different for different HMDs
- Fixed issue with enemies clipping through walls and various other bugs
- Updated hand swap mode to also swap the menu button
- Updated player icon to show Steam avatar

notes.title: Content Update 6/4/2022
notes.content:
Crunch Element is pleased to announce the release of a new update! Magnified optics are finally here along with a new health syringe, bug fixes, and more! As always, please ping me with your feedback and bug reports in the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/vutD5y4]Discord channel[/url] so this game can get even better! If you are enjoying the game so far, consider leaving a review on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090250/Crunch_Element/]store page[/url]. It goes a long way towards helping more people find out about the game!

[h2]New 1-6x LPVO Optic[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/8bf48c5fff0dd7f46b5c4a77bcb7fed4f64a7fee.gif[/img]
This variable optic allows for quick target acquisition at 1x magnification while also enabling long range shots at 6x magnification. Scope magnification can be adjusted by pressing the trigger while hovering the scope.

[h2]New 4x Optic[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/87674845f7a9ffd82d3b0d3c1e7a5c95f848aabe.gif[/img]
This fixed-zoom scope is a classic optic providing 4x magnification for both close and medium range encounters. 

[h2]New health syringe[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/8952ef379908aacbfda622ccc5a9f655a8edfa75.gif[/img]
The new health syringe can heal up to 100 hitpoints so you can quickly get back into the fight! It can be purchased in the truck shop during operations and it can be used across multiple stages.

[h2]Sandbox Updates[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/ea7340877359ea58dcafdad33675701457476283.gif[/img]
The sandbox received a few updates! Targets have been updated to have more visible hit locations with reactive feedback to optimize your live-fire training. A new item spawner has also been added to allow you to quickly test new items and weapon setups.

notes.title: Operations Update!
notes.content:
The Operations update is finally out on the default branch! Throughout the year, the experimental branch was where most of the updates went out to. This is finally changing now that the default branch has been updated! So what's new?

[h3]Operations Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/c7cccd895b42eb9e05b00bf8f6e982a4356ec2ae.gif[/img]
Operations is a new flagship mode that strings together a series of designed scenarios. Salvage loot found in levels to buy more items, health, ammo, and explosives along the way! Your progress is carried from one stage to the next until you die or complete all the missions in the Operation. Currently 3 stages are chosen from the scenario pool, but this is subject to change.

You can also play these designed scenarios individually as a challenge! Master your tactics on the 10 unique scenarios featured in the Operations mode. Mix up your approach, try new gear, and see how smoothly you can operate... New scenarios are constantly being added!

[h3]Interaction System[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/8d4df2d2d4823927cf7cda36074be9d1389075ff.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/8d4df2d2d4823927cf7cda36074be9d1389075ff.gif[/img][/url]
In order to lay the foundation for the many exciting things on the roadmap, a new interaction system was implemented to unleash Crunch Element's potential. Everything including the player rig, items, and weapons were reworked to use this system. This results in a higher fidelity of physics interactions with the environment, new items that take advantage of this, and new quality of life features like force grabbing!

[h3]Items, Gear, and Inventory[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/a04948465380e145f54ddc16d35b1225d7a2fbdb.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/a04948465380e145f54ddc16d35b1225d7a2fbdb.gif[/img][/url]
To bring out more from Crunch Element and pave the way future game modes, there's now a stronger emphasis on items. The introduction of the new inventory system will allow for a more in-depth management of items which will include things like weapons, individual magazines, health items, and more. For quick access, there are slots on the player's "hotbar" which is always in front of them. For longer term storage and collecting items, players can utilize the new backpack.

[h3]Attachments and Customization[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/85c78052ea904f494656fd918f1ccdabb654d164.png[/img]
A brand new attachment and weapon modification system has also been implemented! Players can customize their weapons before heading out on operations with various types of attachments such as muzzle devices, grips, lights, optics, and more. Eventually, both weapons and attachments will be unlockable, but for now they are all available for testing purposes.

[h3]New Objectives[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/4d156c9112484e4a6028b4b7037f9b85931d138a.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Intervention[/b] - Defuse the Scavenger explosives before they destroy Enterprise equipment.
[*][b]Sabotage[/b] - Players must destroy the signal relay and escape back to the vehicle.
[*][b]Espionage[/b] - Locate and retrieve the intel located in the compound, and return to the vehicle safely.
[*][b]Exterminate[/b] - Identify and eliminate all enemy targets.
[/list]

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
[list]
[*]Enhanced enemy AI
[*]Progression and unlocks
[*]Performance improvements
[*]Player rig polish
[*]New maps
[*]New items and attachments
[*]And more!
[/list]

notes.title: Progress Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since the last Steam announcement, but that doesn't mean things have been quiet behind the scenes. Far from it in fact. Throughout this year, many prototypes were made, ideas tested, and systems developed all with the purpose of making Crunch Element all it can be.

In short, Crunch Element is going back to the basics, focusing on what makes it unique: destruction in a CQB setting. What does this mean? Higher fidelity interaction, a bigger focus on gear + attachments, and handcrafted levels that enable consistently enjoyable gameplay. See the latest devlog for an in depth discussion about progress this year. Some ultra-experimental stuff is on the test_interaction branch which is used for testing these new systems. A top priority for the end of this year is getting everything synced up and rock solid on the main branch. If you want to put your testing hat on and get down to business tracking bugs and providing feedback, then jump in the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/vutD5y4]Discord server here[/url].

[previewyoutube=7itIJSbENQU;full][/previewyoutube]

Now onto the exciting bits. What has already been implemented and currently in testing?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/8d4df2d2d4823927cf7cda36074be9d1389075ff.gif[/img]

[h2]A New Interaction System[/h2]
In order to lay the foundation for the many exciting things on the roadmap, a new interaction system was a necessary component to unleash Crunch Element's potential. Everything including the player rig, items, and weapons were reworked to use this system. This results in a higher fidelity of physics interactions with the environment, new items that take advantage of this, and new quality of life features like force grabbing!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/b0b5a8fd21a2d9f7c6b78e93e6ecf037588b6245.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/b0b5a8fd21a2d9f7c6b78e93e6ecf037588b6245.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]A larger focus on items and gear[/h2]
To bring out more from Crunch Element and pave the way future game modes, there's now a stronger emphasis on items. The introduction of the new inventory system will allow for a more in-depth management of items which will include things like weapons, individual magazines, health items, and more. For quick access, there are slots on the player's "hotbar" which is always in front of them. For longer term storage and collecting items, players can utilize the new backpack.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/a04948465380e145f54ddc16d35b1225d7a2fbdb.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/a04948465380e145f54ddc16d35b1225d7a2fbdb.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Attachments and customization[/h2]
A brand new attachment and weapon modification system has also been implement and currently in testing! Player's can customize their weapons before heading out on operations with various types of attachments such as muzzle devices, grips, lights, optics, and more. Eventually, both weapons and attachments will be unlockable, but for now they are all available for testing purposes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/85c78052ea904f494656fd918f1ccdabb654d164.png[/img]

[h2]New objectives[/h2]
The following are the objectives currently being tested. Each stage will contain one or more objectives, which will be strung together to make an "Operation" (more on that later).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/fdc64b1179ff771aa721fb79a1211022b91e4e63.png[/img]

[h3]Intervention[/h3]
Defuse the Scavenger explosives before they destroy Enterprise equipment.

[h3]Sabotage[/h3]
Players must destroy the signal relay and escape back to the vehicle.

[h3]Espionage[/h3]
Locate and retrieve the intel located in the compound, and return to the vehicle safely.

[h3]Exterminate[/h3]
Identify and eliminate all enemy targets.


[h2]Various improvements and fixes along the way[/h2]
- Fixed many issues regarding sound (sound cutoff, mixing issues, etc)
- Implemented sound mixing
- Ambient sounds
- New destruction module types (brick, different floors, barricades, etc)
- Graphics improvements
- Performance improvements

[h2]What's to come[/h2]
- A new flagship "Operations" mode with roguelike progression
- Many more stages
- Consumable health items
- More attachment types and weapon parts
- Global progression (item and attachment unlocks)
- Enemy improvements
- Various enemy types

Lastly, I'd like to thank everyone for their patience. Striving to build something people enjoy isn't always quick nor seamless, but it's extremely rewarding to see all of the long term work of the past year finally come together. I'm looking forward to hearing your feedback about the new systems and I hope you are excited as I am for the what's to come!

If you'd like to stay up to date through smaller and more frequent updates, consider following [url=https://twitter.com/CrunchElementVR]Crunch Element on Twitter[/url].

- Blake

notes.title: First week update recap!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been just over a week since the initial early access release, and I'd love to take the time to go over the changes that have been made so far. I'd also like to thank everyone who has been giving quality feedback on the [url=https://crunchelement.nolt.io/]feedback board[/url]. Your feedback has been instrumental in making sure the right tasks are being worked on, and I appreciate your patience as I tackle the most pressing items while still keeping things exciting and on-target in accordance with the [url=https://youtu.be/J_npwRKTDuc]early access roadmap[/url]. Most of the changes so far address the most common feedback which is performance, gameplay, and quality of life (settings). Performance has been significantly increased and will be constantly improving down the line.

[h2]Performance Updates[/h2]
Average CPU frame time in compounds has been reduced by 25%! This breakthrough now allows huge compounds to be made with little performance hit, making the new CPU bottleneck the number of active enemies. Comparative GPU optimizations have also been made by means of GPU instancing, static batching, and distance-activated realtime lights.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
As stated in the [url=https://youtu.be/J_npwRKTDuc]roadmap devlog[/url], intensifying the attacking/defending moments is critical to enabling exciting and memorable gameplay. This week, enemies now hold their ground on defense and spawn based on the objective's location. Most of the future updates will be dealing with further improving the enemies and their role as defenders.

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]
Quite a few QoL updates have been push out and many more are on the way! Thank you for your patience as I do my best to implement these requests in the best way possible.

notes.title: The experimental branch is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116340/639442dc9d3d18fcdd54641938b62b0c761ed857.gif[/img]

[h1]Calling all testers! It's your time to shine[/h1]
There are two core initiatives in making Crunch Element the best it can be: getting quicker feedback and storing feedback in an organized way.

[h3]Live updates straight from the development server[/h3]
Squashing the iteration cycle time is critical in making a game that players enjoy in the end, and a game that "just feels right" in every respect. 

The feedback iteration cycle is the process of going from code/art -> playable Steam build -> tester feedback -> code/art (based on feedback). The faster this cycle takes place, the more Crunch Element improves and the more time is spent on effective development. In the last few days, a new solution has been set up to convert this process which used to be done by hand and take a good portion of a day, to a process that requires less than 60 seconds of developer time and moves project files to a playable steam update in about 30 minutes. 

This means that testers will receive a constant stream of updates from the development server if they are on the 'experimental' branch on Steam (read how to access it below). [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/vutD5y4]In the Discord server,[/url] Crunch Element's trusty bot Changelogger will be jotting down the latest patch notes in the #changelog channel so testers never miss an update. By the time you read it there, a new update will already be going through the Steam pipes (if you are on the experimental branch). 
 
[h3]A centralized place for bug reports and suggestions[/h3]
There is now a centralized place for feedback and bug reports! Please direct all suggestions, bug reports, and ideas to the [url=http://crunchelement.nolt.io/]official Crunch Element Nolt board[/url]! You can vote on suggestions and have discussion within posts. This will allow greater visibility for in-demand features and common bugs that surface. You will also be able to easily see the status of an idea if it's ever planned and implemented!

[h2]How to get access[/h2]
To access the experimental branch, right click on Crunch Element in your Steam library (if you have testing access), go to 'properties' -> 'betas' Then select the 'experimental' branch which will then download.
The default branch will periodically update with stable versions from the experimental branch. If you would much rather prefer to play on the latest stable version rather than testing the absolute latest version, it is recommended to stay on the default branch.

notes.title: Climbing and Weapon Cycling! Patch Notes 0.2.0
notes.content:
Super excited to announce the newest feature update to Crunch Element! Below are some of the highlights of the update.

[h1]Weapon Cycling[/h1]
[list]
[*]Magazine-fed weapons use bullet chambering functionality! Insert a magazine and rack the slide back using the trigger to chamber a round. 
[*]The last shot fired from a magazine will leave the slide open. 
[*]Either manually pull the slide back or release the slide using the new “slide release” binding (Touchpad up on Vive, double click eject button on Rift and Index).
[/list]
[h1]Climbing[/h1]
[list]
[*]The first iteration of climbing has been introduced into testing!
[*]Use the grip buttons to grab onto a wall and alternate hands to pull yourself up
[*]Added a parkour section to the sandbox level for testing
[*]All buildings are climbable, however some floors are neither grab-able or destructible (changing it up during the next update)
[/list]
[h1]Going Forward[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adding settings menu so players can toggle settings such as holster placement, head-oriented walking direction, snap/smooth rotation option, and more.
[*]More weapons! Now that the fundamentals are (finally) in place for weapons, you can expect to see a whole slew of weapons to join the party
[*]Enemy overhaul. Don’t worry, the enemies ARE getting better. This is being done in parallel with this update. Expect to see improvements in animation, realism, and less-jankyness overall.
[*]New compounds. It’s about time that more levels are added, as well as giving the current compounds a face-lift. Expect to see 10 stages available with the release of closed beta (coming mid-September), as well as short-term experimental stages with new architecture. Closed beta will available to everyone who [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/vutD5y4]joins the Discord[/url]
[/list]
